blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.
blocks.zh: 从可核查的奖励(RLVR)中加强学习受到对硬推理任务的少量结果层面反馈的限制:当一个团体的所有推出失败时,奖励不会提供学习信号. 强壮的教师可以提供额外的指导,但这提出了一个中心问题:如何将这些信号纳入RLVR,以支持成功的推广,同时让学生能够学习? 我们区分两种互补机制:轨迹层面的干预,这种干预改善了获得奖励的轨迹的机会;和象征性层面的监管,这种监管为指导学生学习提供了密集的目标。 我们的受控实验表明,任何一种机制都可能仍然不足,促使它们结合。 因此,我们引入了PIVOT,它将教师产生的校正纳入学生的推广,并将象征性的KL监督与RLVR目标一起应用于这些部分。 除了两者的结合外,我们系统地分析在哪里进行干预和如何监督,从而产生有效指导的良方。 透过硬逻辑游戏和数学推理基准, PIVOT 持续超越现有方法,

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overview of PIVOT .
For each query, the policy model samples a group of rollouts, including teacher-assisted trajectories.
In a teacher-assisted rollout, the student first generates a prefix, the teacher provides a correction segment, and the student then continues generation.
The completed trajectory is optimized by the verifier-based GRPO objective, while the teacher-generated segment provides dense token-level supervision through a teacher-student KL loss.

图1:PIVOT概览.

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a dominant paradigm for eliciting reasoning in large language models ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Despite its success, recent studies suggest that RLVR primarily amplifies reasoning behaviors present in the base model, raising questions about its ability to acquire new capabilities ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
This limitation is particularly pronounced on hard problems for which the initial policy rarely generates a correct solution ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) .
In this regime, sparse outcome-level rewards provide little information for policy improvement: groups of unsuccessful rollouts receive identical zero rewards, leaving the policy without a reward-based learning signal ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Tao et al., 2025 ) .
These challenges have motivated the use of stronger teachers to provide guidance beyond verifier feedback.
However, introducing teacher signals does not by itself ensure that the student can learn from them.
This raises a central question: how can teacher guidance support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student?
blocks.zh:
强化对可核查奖励的学习(RLVR)已成为在大语言模型中引领推理的主导范例(Shao等,2024;Lambert等,2024;Guo等,2025)。
尽管取得了成功,但最近的研究表明,RLVR主要放大了基础模型中存在的推理行为,对其获得新能力的能力提出了质疑(Yue等,2025;Zhao等,2025).
这一限制在最初政策很少产生正确解决办法的难题上尤为明显(Yan等,2026;Chen等,2025;Qu等,2026)。
在这个制度中,鲜有的成果级奖励为政策改进提供了很少的信息:不成功的推出团体获得同样的零分奖励,使政策没有基于奖励的学习信号(Wu等,2026;Tao等,2025)。
这些挑战促使使用更强大的教师提供超出核查反馈的指导。
然而,引入教师信号本身并不能确保学生能够从中学习.
这提出了一个中心问题:教师指导如何支持成功的推广,同时为学生继续学习?

blocks.en:
Existing approaches incorporate teacher signals into RLVR through two broad mechanisms. Trajectory-level intervention introduces teacher-generated trajectories or segments into training, improving access to reward-bearing trajectories ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) .
However, teacher-generated trajectories may differ substantially from the student’s own rollout distribution, making the teacher’s behavior difficult to learn even when these trajectories are successful. Token-level supervision , in contrast, provides dense supervision along student-generated rollouts using the teacher’s predictive distributions ( Xu et al., 2025 ) .
Yet when these rollouts deviate from a valid reasoning path, local corrective signals may not support a coherent recovery.
These limitations suggest that effective teacher guidance must shape both the trajectories used for training and the supervision derived from them.
blocks.zh:
现有方法通过两个广泛的机制将教师信号纳入RLVR。 轨迹层面的干预将教师产生的轨迹或部分引入培训,改善获得有奖轨迹的机会(Guo等,2025;Wen等,2025;Yan等,2025;Qu等,2026)。
然而,教师产生的轨迹可能与学生本身的推广分布大相径庭,即使这些轨迹成功,教师的行为也难以学习. 反之,Token层面的监管(徐等,2025年)。
然而,当这些推出偏离有效的推理途径时,当地纠正信号可能无法支持协调一致的复苏。
这些限制表明,有效的教师指导必须既决定用于培训的轨迹,也决定由此产生的监督。

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce P rogressive I nter v ention via O nline T eacher Correction (PIVOT), a teacher-assisted RLVR framework that integrates teacher corrections into both rollout generation and policy optimization. PIVOT augments the rollout group with teacher-assisted trajectories, in which the teacher provides a correction based on a student-generated prefix and the student continues from the corrected context.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , verifier-based RLVR optimizes the resulting trajectories, while a teacher–student KL objective provides dense token-level supervision on the correction segments.
Our controlled experiments show that this joint use of teacher signals yields stronger learning than either intervention or token-level supervision alone.
We further examine how intervention placement and the KL objective affect the effectiveness of teacher guidance, informing a concrete recipe for where to intervene, how to supervise, and how much teacher guidance to apply.

因此,我们介绍 Progressive I nter v ention通过O nline T Eacher 校正(PIVOT),这是一个由教师协助的RLVR框架,将教师校正纳入推出生成和政策优化之中. PIVOT用由教师辅助的出道轨迹来扩充出道组,其中由教师根据学生生成的前缀进行校正,由学生从校正上下文继续.
如图1所示,基于核查器的RLVR优化了由此产生的轨迹,而师生的KL目标则对校正部分提供密集的符号级监督.
我们的受控实验表明,这种联合使用教师信号的做法比仅仅干预或象征性监督更能产生更大的学习效果。
我们进一步审查干预安排和 " KL " 目标如何影响教师指导的有效性,为在何处干预、如何监督以及教师指导可适用多少具体方法提供信息。

blocks.en:
We evaluate PIVOT on hard logic games from SynLogic ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
On hard logic games, where RL-only training makes limited progress, PIVOT nearly doubles mean avg@8 from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.
On mathematical reasoning tasks, PIVOT consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们从SynLogic(刘等,2026年)和数学推理基准来评价PIVOT的硬逻辑游戏.
在硬逻辑游戏中,仅RL的训练进展有限,PIVOT几乎双倍表示avg@8,表现最好的基线从19.5%到35.6%.
在数学推理任务方面,PIVOT在分配基准和分配外基准两方面的业绩始终高于评估的基线。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We identify two complementary mechanisms for teacher guidance in RLVR— trajectory-level intervention and token-level supervision —and show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient for effective learning on hard reasoning tasks. • We introduce PIVOT , a teacher-assisted RLVR framework that integrates teacher corrections into both rollout generation and policy optimization, and provide a systematic analysis of how teacher guidance should be incorporated into training. • We conduct extensive experiments and show that PIVOT nearly doubles mean avg@8 over the best-performing baseline on hard logic games while consistently outperforming baselines across in-distribution and out-of-distribution mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

blocks.en: 3  RLVR through Teacher Intervention and Supervision
blocks.zh: 3 RLVR 通过教师干预和监督

blocks.en:
Teacher guidance can shape both the trajectories a student explores (i.e., trajectory-level intervention ) and the learning signals it receives (i.e., token-level supervision ).
Existing methods typically emphasize one of these two mechanisms.
Below, we examine why either mechanism alone can be insufficient for effective student learning and how combining them motivates the design of PIVOT .
blocks.zh:
教师指导既可以塑造学生探索的轨迹(即轨迹级干预),也可以塑造其收到的学习信号(即象征级监督).
现有方法通常强调这两种机制之一。
校对:Soup

blocks.en: 3.1  Reward-Bearing Trajectories Are Not Necessarily Learnable
blocks.zh: 3.1 奖励-受援轨迹不一定能够学习

blocks.en: While the student may struggle to discover successful trajectories, trajectory-level intervention by a stronger teacher provides access to reward-bearing reasoning paths.
blocks.zh: 虽然学生可能为发现成功的轨迹而挣扎,但由更强大的教师进行的轨迹层面的干预提供了获得奖励的推理途径。

blocks.en:
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on these trajectories provides a warm start for subsequent RL ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) , while LUFFY incorporates successful teacher trajectories directly into RL training ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .
POPE instead provides a teacher-generated prefix and lets the student generate the remaining continuation ( Qu et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches differ in when and how teacher trajectories enter training, but all use teacher-generated trajectories or segments to improve access to successful reasoning paths.
blocks.zh:
对这些轨迹的监督微调(SFT)为之后的RL(郭等,2025;文等,2025;而LUFFY将成功的教师轨迹直接纳入RL培训(Yan等,2025.))提供了一个温暖的开端.
POPE则提供由教师生成的前缀,让学生生成剩余的续作(Qu等,2026.).
这些方法在教师的轨迹进入培训的时间和方式上有所不同,但都使用由教师产生的轨迹或段来改善成功推理路径的获取.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Prefix supervision vs. prefix-only guidance on Survo.
Supervised prefixes improve rewards, while POPE-style prefixes fail to yield comparable gains.
blocks.zh:
图2 : Survo上的前缀监督与前缀唯一的指导.
被监督的前缀会改进奖励,而POPE式前缀则无法产生相可比较的收益.

blocks.en:
The success of a teacher trajectory, however, does not ensure that its behavior is readily learnable by the student.
Full teacher trajectories may differ substantially from the student’s own rollout distribution, making them difficult imitation targets even when they receive positive rewards.
Providing only a teacher prefix allows the student to generate its own continuation, but learning to continue from a supplied prefix does not necessarily teach the student to produce the teacher decisions encoded in that prefix during independent generation.
blocks.zh:
然而,教师轨迹的成功并不能确保学生能够随时学习其行为。
完全的教师轨迹可能与学生本身的推广分布大相径庭,即使他们得到积极的奖励,也使他们难以模仿目标。
仅提供教师前缀可以让学生产生自己的续作,但从所提供的前缀中学习继续,并不一定会教学生在独立一代期间制作该前缀所编码的教师决定.

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 illustrates this distinction on Survo.
POPE yields limited gains even with stronger teacher prefixes.
We additionally consider oracle prefixes extracted from correct solutions to test whether prefix errors account for the limited gains.
Even with these prefixes, POPE makes little progress, whereas adding explicit teacher supervision on the provided prefixes improves training rewards.
This contrast suggests that prefix quality alone does not determine the usefulness of teacher guidance: the training objective must also enable the student to learn from the teacher-provided behavior.
blocks.zh:
图2说明了苏尔沃的这种区别。
即使教师前缀更坚固,POPE的收益也有限。
我们还考虑从正确的解决方案中提取的甲骨文前缀来测试前缀错误是否计入了有限的收益.
即使有了这些前缀,POPE也没有取得什么进展,而在所提供的前缀上加上明确的教师监督会提高培训奖励。
这一对比表明,单靠前缀质量并不能决定教师指导的用处:培训目标还必须使学生能够从教师提供的行为中学习.

blocks.en: 3.2  Dense Supervision Does Not Guarantee Trajectory Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 强化监督 不保证轨道恢复

blocks.en:
Unlike trajectory-level intervention, token-level supervision introduces teacher guidance directly into the learning objective.
KDRL ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , for example, combines GRPO with reverse-KL distillation along student-generated rollouts.
The teacher provides dense feedback at each token, but the student still determines the reasoning path and hence the contexts on which supervision is applied.
blocks.zh:
与轨迹层面的干预不同,象征性层面的监督直接将教师指导引入了学习目标.
例如,KDRL(徐等,2025年)将GRPO和逆-KL蒸馏结合到学生产生的推出上.
教师在每个方面都提供密集的反馈,但学生仍然决定着推理路径,从而决定了实施监督的背景。

blocks.en:
This dependence on student-generated contexts can complicate recovery from reasoning errors.
As observed in Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD) ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , when a student prefix contains errors that require backtracking, the teacher may assign high probability both to continuing the student’s reasoning and to initiating a correction.
Under such prefix failure, the resulting bimodal teacher mixture provides conflicting targets for token-level supervision.
blocks.zh:
这种对学生产生背景的依赖可能使推理错误的恢复复杂化.
正如Trajectory-Refined Distillation(TRD)(Jiang等,2026年)所观察到的,当学生的前缀含有需要回溯的错误时,老师可能会为继续学生的推理和启动校正分配高概率.
在这种前缀失效的情况下,由此产生的双模式教师混合物为象征性监督提供了相冲突的目标。

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 (left) illustrates this issue on a Survo rollout trained with KDRL.
After an early error, the student continues along the wrong path and the rollout ends with zero reward.
At the supervised positions, teacher predictions repeatedly split between corrective tokens ( “Wait” ) and tokens that continue the reasoning ( “Let” , “So” ), pulling the student in two directions at once.
Even when the teacher favors a correction, the remainder of the training sequence is still the student’s erroneous continuation.
The student thus receives local corrective signals without observing how the proposed recovery unfolds.
When successful student rollouts are rare, training provides few examples of how to recover from an initial error and carry the revised reasoning through to a correct solution, limiting the ability of supervision alone to guide the student toward successful completion.
blocks.zh:

早期出错后,学生继续走错误的道路,推出以零分奖励结束.

blocks.en:
The preceding results suggest that the value of teacher guidance depends on both the reasoning paths it introduces and the supervision applied along those paths.
For methods relying solely on trajectory-level intervention , Fig. 2 shows that adding a teacher-matching loss enables the student to learn more effectively from the provided prefixes.
For methods that apply token-level supervision solely along student-generated rollouts, Fig. 3 (right) shows how teacher intervention changes the supervision: the teacher generates a recovery path that becomes part of the training sequence and leads to a successful solution, providing largely unimodal targets both when initiating a correction ( “Wait” ) and when continuing the revised reasoning ( “So” ).

blocks.en: 4.1  Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on hard logic games and mathematical reasoning.
For logic games, we train and evaluate on the hard subsets of Survo, Minesweeper, and Kakurasu from SynLogic ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , on which the base student almost never succeeds.
For mathematical reasoning, we pool problems from Polaris-53K ( An et al., 2025 ) and the math subset of Skywork-OR1-RL-Data ( He et al., 2025 ) .
We screen this pool with the base student Qwen3-4B, retaining challenging problems with low empirical success rates.
After removing problems with invalid answers and removing overlap with out-of-distribution benchmarks, we sample 30k training, 1k validation, and 2k held-out in-distribution test problems (Math-ID) from the filtered pool.
We also evaluate on the out-of-distribution benchmarks AIME 2024/2025 ( Li et al., 2024 ) and MATH500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们进行硬逻辑游戏和数学推理的实验.
对于逻辑游戏,我们训练和评价来自SynLogic(刘等,2026年)的Survo,Minesweeper和Kakurasu等硬子集,基础生在其中几乎从未成功.
对于数学推理,我们汇集了从Polaris-53K(An等,2025年)和Skywork-OR1-RL-Data(He等,2025年)的数学子集的问题.

在去除无效答案的问题并去除与分配出基准的重叠后,我们从被过滤的池中抽取出30k训练,1k验证,和2k被扣留的分布出测试问题(Math-ID).
我们还评估分配外基准AIME 2024/2025(Li等,2024年)和MATH500(Hendrycks等,2021年).

blocks.en: 4.2  Where Should the Teacher Intervene?
blocks.zh: 4.2 教师干预应在哪里?

blocks.en:
To study how intervention timing affects student learning, we compare prefix intervention ( ℓ u = 0 \ell_{u}=0 ) with intervention after a short student attempt ( ℓ u ∈ { 512 , 1024 , 2048 } \ell_{u}\in\{512,1024,2048\} ), keeping the teacher-segment budget fixed. Table 1 shows that ℓ u = 512 \ell_{u}=512 middle intervention improves avg@8 and pass@8 over prefix intervention across all three games, with the largest gains on Minesweeper and Kakurasu.
We include a brief case study to further examine why middle intervention helps in practice.
blocks.zh:
为了研究干预时间如何影响学生的学习,我们将前缀干预(l u = 0\ell_{u}=0)与短期学生尝试后的干预(l u { 512, 1024, 2048}}\ell_{u}\in\{512, 1024, 2048\})相提并论,使教师部分的预算保持不变. 表1显示,我u = 512\ ellu\\\ 512 中间干预改进了avg@8,并在所有三场比赛中通过@8前缀干预,在扫雷和Kakurasu上收获最大.
我们包括一个简短的案例研究,以进一步审查为什么中间干预有助于实践。

blocks.en:
Why does middle intervention help? We compare two explanations for the effect of intervention timing: 1. Later tokens are more informative. Early tokens may largely restate the problem or organize its conditions. Moving supervision later could thus make better use of the same distillation budget. 2. Student-conditioned guidance is more learnable. Conditioning teacher guidance on the student’s partial solution may make it easier for the student to learn how to continue or recover. Figure 4: Effect of opening source on Minesweeper. We test these explanations by replacing the student-generated prefix with a teacher-generated one, leaving the rest of the rollout unchanged. Since the teacher may provide a stronger starting point, if middle intervention helps by shifting supervision to more informative tokens, this variant should match or surpass student-prefix intervention. Yet this replacement substantially reduces performance ( Fig. 4 ), supporting the second explanation.
This result echoes the motivation behind DAgger ( Ross et al., 2011 ) and on-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) , which expose the learner to states from its own rollouts. From these states, the teacher can help the student build on partial reasoning or correct mistakes.
blocks.zh:
为什么中间干预有帮助? 我们比较了干预时间效应的两个解释: 1. 后期的标志信息更加丰富。 早期的标志可能在很大程度上重复问题或组织其条件. 因此,以后转移监督可以更好地利用同样的蒸馏预算。 2. 以学生为条件的指导比较容易学习。 对学生的部分解决方案进行有条件的教师指导,可能使学生更容易学习如何继续或恢复. 图 4: 开源对扫雷器的影响。 我们测试这些解释,把学生产生的前缀取而代之的是教师产生的前缀,剩下的推出部分保持不变. 由于教师可提供一个更强有力的起点,如果中间干预有助于将监管转向信息更加丰富的标志,这种变体应当与学生前置干预相匹配或超越。 然而,这一更换大大降低了业绩(图4),支持了第二项解释。
这一结果与Dagger背后的动机(Ross等人,2011年)和关于政策的分馏(Agarwal等人,2024年)相呼应,后者让学习者从自己的推出中接触到各州. 从这些州来看,老师可以帮助学生以部分推理为基础或纠正错误.

A longer student prefix, however, does not necessarily make this guidance more effective.
On Minesweeper, for example, avg@8 falls from 19.25% at ℓ u = 512 \ell_{u}=512 to 12.50% at ℓ u = 2048 \ell_{u}=2048 , below the 14.81% achieved by prefix intervention.
We also observe more truncation with later intervention.
A longer student prefix leaves fewer tokens to continue generating after the teacher segment, especially when earlier steps need to be revised.
As a result, the rollout may reach the length limit before the student can complete the revised reasoning and produce a final answer.

blocks.en: 4.3  How Should the Teacher Supervise?
blocks.zh: 4.3 教师应如何监督?

blocks.en:
Beyond where the teacher intervenes, the form of supervision also matters for student learning.
A common approach is to minimize the KL divergence between the student and teacher token distributions, providing dense token-level supervision ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
The forward- and reverse-KL objectives introduced in Section 2 both encourage distribution matching, but take expectations under the teacher and student token distributions, respectively.
We compare these objectives within PIVOT to examine how the choice of KL direction affects learning from teacher-generated segments across tasks with different levels of initial competence.
blocks.zh:
除教师干预外,监督形式对学生学习也很重要。
一种常见的做法是尽量减少学生和教师代币分配之间的KL差异,提供密集的代币级别监督(Agarwal等,2024;徐等,2025)。
第2节中引入的前向和倒向KL目标都鼓励分配匹配,但将预期值分别放在教师和学生象征性分配项下。
我们比较了PIVOT内部的这些目标,以审查选择KL方向如何影响从教师产生的各段学习,涉及不同级别初始能力的任务。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Reverse KL favors low initial accuracy; forward KL has a modest advantage at higher accuracy. Dashed lines mark base accuracy. Panels use different scales; labels show gains over the other KL, colored by the better KL.
blocks.zh: 图6:逆向KL偏好低初始精度;前向KL在高精度方面有微弱优势. 折射线标出基准精度. 面板使用不同的鳞片;标签显示相对于其它KL的增益,颜色由更好的KL所取.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 shows that reverse KL performs better on all three hard logic games, where the base student almost never succeeds: mean avg@8 rises from 24.5% to 35.6%, and mean pass@8 from 54.2% to 63.8%, relative to forward KL ( Tab. 4 ).
On math benchmarks, both objectives improve average accuracy over the base model.
On the challenging Math-ID, where the base model achieves only 5.04% accuracy, reverse KL slightly outperforms forward KL by 0.57 percentage points.
On the OOD benchmarks AIME 2024/2025 and MATH500, where the student already solves a substantial fraction of problems, forward KL yields modestly larger gains in average accuracy ( Tab. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
图6显示,反向KL在所有三个硬逻辑游戏上表现较好,基础学生几乎从未成功:平均avg@8从24.5%升至35.6%;平均通过@8从54.2%升至63.8%,相对前向KL(Tab. 4).
在数学基准方面,这两个目标都比基准模型提高了平均准确性。
在挑战性的Math-ID上,基础模型仅能实现5.04%的精度,反转KL稍快于前方KL0.57个百分点.
在AOME 2024/2025和MATH500这两个基准上,学生已经解决了相当一部分问题,向前KL在平均准确度方面得到的增益略高(图5)。

blocks.en:
A possible explanation lies in the mode-seeking and mode-covering tendencies of reverse and forward KL ( Tajwar et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Reverse KL discourages the student from assigning probability to continuations the teacher considers unlikely, favoring concentration on teacher-preferred modes.
When the student rarely succeeds, learning to reliably produce even one effective reasoning mode could yield substantial progress.
With reliable teacher guidance, this concentration may help the student establish a solution strategy that it previously struggled to produce independently.
Once successful reasoning is already accessible, learning additional effective strategies may offer further room for improvement across different problems.
Forward KL encourages coverage of teacher-supported alternatives, including those the student currently assigns little probability, and may therefore support this broader learning.
The results are consistent with this interpretation, though they do not directly measure changes in reasoning-mode coverage.
blocks.zh:
一种可能的解释在于反向和前向KL的寻找模式和覆盖模式的趋势(Tajwar等,2024;Li等,2026)。
反向 KL 阻止学生为老师认为不太可能的续作分配概率, 倾向于专注于老师偏好的模式 。
当学生很少成功时,学会可靠地产生甚至一种有效的推理模式,可以产生实质性的进展.
有了可靠的教师指导,这种集中可能帮助学生制定其以前为独立制作而奋斗的解决方案策略.
一旦能够成功推理,学习其他有效战略就可能为不同问题提供进一步改进的余地。
前方KL鼓励涵盖教师支持的替代方法,包括目前学生分配的概率很小的替代方法,因此可能支持这种更广泛的学习。
结果与这种解释一致,尽管它们并不直接衡量推理-模式覆盖的变化.

blocks.en: We therefore favor reverse KL, given its substantial gains on hard tasks and the modest accuracy advantage of forward KL when initial success rates are higher.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们赞成反之以KL,因为它在艰巨任务上取得了巨大进展,而且当初步成功率较高时,前方KL的准确性优势不大。

blocks.en:
Takeaway. The student’s starting point can inform the choice of KL objective.
When success is rare, reverse KL’s mode-seeking tendency may help the student establish a viable reasoning strategy.
Forward KL offers a modest accuracy advantage at higher initial success rates, whereas reverse KL yields larger gains on hard tasks.
blocks.zh:
外卖 学生的起点可以告知KL目标的选择。
当成功是罕见的时,反向KL的寻找模式倾向可能有助于学生建立可行的推理策略.
远期KL在较高的初始成功率下提供微小的精度优势,而逆向KL则在艰巨任务上产生更大的收益.

blocks.en: 4.4  What Else Matters for Teacher Guidance?
blocks.zh: 4.4 教师指导的其他问题是什么?

blocks.en:
With the intervention position and supervision objective fixed, we investigate which other aspects of teacher guidance affect student learning.
We vary teacher capacity, the allocation of a fixed teacher-token budget across assisted rollouts, and the support size of the top- k k approximation. Figure 7 summarizes ablations, which vary one factor at a time while keeping other settings fixed.
blocks.zh:
随着干预立场和监督目标的确定,我们调查教师指导的其他方面影响学生的学习。
我们的师资能力各不相同, 固定的师资预算被分配到助推阶段, 图7总结了各种因素,这些因素在保持其他设置固定的同时,会同时不同。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Calibrating teacher guidance on hard logic games under middle intervention with forward KL. Each column varies one factor from the default setting, which is shaded. Solid lines denote avg@8 and dashed lines denote pass@8. Full numbers are given in Tab. 6 in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 图7 :校正教师在中导干涉下对硬逻辑游戏的指导与前导 KL. 每个列与默认设置不同一个因子,默认设置为阴影. 实线表示avg@8,虚线表示通过@8. 全部数字在 Tab 中给出。 附录第6段。

blocks.en:
We examine whether the student benefits from a stronger teacher by replacing Qwen3-4B-Thinking with Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking.
The stronger teacher improves avg@8 across all three games: performance more than doubles on Minesweeper, from 19.25 % 19.25\% to 40.12 % 40.12\% , and increases nearly fivefold on Kakurasu, from 3.52 % 3.52\% to 17.27 % 17.27\% , while the improvement on Survo is more modest.
These results indicate that PIVOT can make effective use of a more capable teacher despite the larger teacher–student capacity gap.
The additional capability of the teacher translates into improvements in the student’s own problem-solving performance, even on games where learning with the default teacher remains difficult.
blocks.zh:
我们通过用Qune3-30B-A3B-Thinking取代Qune3-4B-Thinking来检查学生是否从更强的老师中受益.
更强的老师在所有三场比赛中都改进了avg@8:在Minesweaper上的表现比双打多,从19.25%19.25分增加到40.12%40.12分;在Kakurasu上则增加了近五倍,从3.52%3.52分增加到17.27分,而Survo的改善则更谦虚.
这些结果表明,尽管师生能力差距较大,但PIVOT能够有效利用能力更强的教师。
教师的附加能力会转化为学生自身解决问题的表现的改善,甚至在与默认教师学习仍然困难的游戏中也是如此.

blocks.en:
We examine how a fixed teacher-token budget should be distributed across assisted rollouts.
Keeping G T × ℓ v G_{T}\times\ell_{v} fixed at 8 8 k tokens, we allocate this budget to either two assisted rollouts with a 4 4 k-token teacher budget each, four with 2 2 k each, or eight with 1 1 k each.
Both avg@8 and pass@8 decline monotonically across all three games as the budget is spread across more rollouts; on Survo, avg@8 falls from 50.70 % 50.70\% to 43.50 % 43.50\% and 33.50 % 33.50\% .
This suggests that longer teacher segments give the student more opportunity to learn from a sustained sequence of connected reasoning or corrective steps, while shorter segments may end before the teacher has fully developed the reasoning needed for the student to continue.
Under the same teacher-token budget, fewer, longer interventions therefore provide more effective guidance in our experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们研究如何将固定的师生预算分配给援助的推广工作。
将G T × l v G → Times\ ell_{v} 固定在 8 8 k 个令牌上, 我们分配这笔预算, 用于两个助推, 每个4 k-token 教师预算, 四个2 k, 或八个1 k。
Avg@8和通过@8均单调地在所有三场比赛中下降,因为预算分散在更多的推广阶段;在Survo,avg@8从50.70% 50.70%下降到43.50% 43.50%和33.50% 33.50%。
这说明较长的教师段让学生有更多的机会从持续序列的连通推理或矫正步骤中学习,而较短的段子可能在教师充分发展出学生继续学习所需的推理之前结束.
因此,在同一师资预算下,较少、更长的干预为我们实验提供了更有效的指导。

blocks.en:
The top- k k approximation controls how much of the teacher’s token distribution is available for supervision.
Our results suggest that effective guidance requires a sufficiently broad set of teacher-supported alternatives, but does not necessarily benefit from retaining more of the distribution.
Moving from k = 10 k=10 to k = 30 k=30 improves both metrics across all three games, whereas increasing k k to 50 offers no consistent benefit and reduces performance on Kakurasu.
This pattern suggests that the most probable teacher tokens alone may provide too narrow a learning signal, while extending supervision to lower-probability alternatives is not uniformly useful.
We therefore use k = 30 k=30 as a balance between supervision quality and the cost of storing and matching teacher logits.
blocks.zh:
Kk近似值控制着教师的代币发行量。
我们的结果显示,有效的指导需要一套足够广泛的教师支持的替代方法,但不一定能从保留更多的分配中受益。
从k=10 k=10到k=30 k=30都改进了所有三场比赛的两种度量衡,而将kk增加至50则不能提供一致的好处并降低Kakurasu的性能.
这种模式表明,光是教师最有可能的标志就可能提供过于狭窄的学习信号,而将监督范围扩大到低概率的替代方法并不统一有用.
因此,我们使用k=30k=30作为监督质量与储存和匹配教师日志的费用之间的平衡。

blocks.en:
Takeaway. A stronger teacher provides better guidance, but making effective use of that guidance also requires careful allocation.
With a fixed teacher-token budget, fewer, longer interventions are more effective than many short ones.
For KL supervision, the teacher distribution should cover enough alternatives for learning; extending to lower-probability tokens offers no consistent benefit.
blocks.zh:
外卖 更强大的教师提供更好的指导,但有效利用这种指导也需要认真分配。
有了固定的教师介绍预算,比许多短期干预更有效,但干预时间更长。
就KL监督而言,教师分配应涵盖足够的学习选择;推广到低概率标志不能提供一致的好处。

blocks.en: 4.5  Putting the Recipe into Practice
blocks.zh: 4.5 将《食谱》付诸实践

blocks.en:
Following the recipe above, we configure PIVOT to intervene after a 512-token student prefix, allowing the teacher to build on the student’s initial reasoning.
For each prompt, we sample six student-only and two teacher-assisted rollouts, concentrating the teacher-token budget on fewer, longer interventions.
We apply teacher–student KL supervision to the teacher-generated segments with a top- k k support of 30.
We favor reverse KL for its substantial gains when initial success is rare, while also reporting the forward-KL variant. Table 2 compares these configurations with baselines.
blocks.zh:
根据上面的配方,我们配置了PIVOT,在512个学生前缀之后进行干预,使教师能够借鉴学生的初步推理。
每一次,我们抽取了6个只有学生和2个教师协助的推广项目,将师资预算集中在更少、更长的干预上。
我们把师生的KL监督应用到师生产生的部分,顶级支持为30克.
我们赞成在初期成功不多的情况下扭转KL的大幅收益,同时报告前向KL的变式。 表2将这些配置与基线进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Main results on hard logic games (Qwen3-1.7B) and math (Qwen3-4B). Math-ID is in-distribution; other math benchmarks are OOD. The base model uses thinking mode. Metrics are avg@8, or avg@64 for AIME. Colored boxes show absolute changes over the base model.
blocks.zh: 表2:硬逻辑游戏(Quen3-1.7B)和数学(Quen3-4B)的主要成绩. 数学-ID是分配的;其他数学基准是OOD. 基础模型采用思维模式. 度量衡为avg@8,或AIME为avg@64. 彩色框显示相对于基模型的绝对变化.

blocks.en:
On the hard logic games, the base student rarely produces a correct solution, and training with outcome rewards alone does little to improve its performance.
Adding teacher-generated segments to rollouts, as in LUFFY and POPE, brings only limited improvements, with both methods performing worse than even the simple SFT+RL baseline.
KDRL provides token-level supervision along student rollouts and makes greater progress, achieving the strongest baseline performance on all three games. PIVOT goes further by pairing teacher-generated reasoning segments with direct supervision on those segments: with reverse KL, it raises mean avg@8 from KDRL’s 19.5 % 19.5\% to 35.6 % 35.6\% .
A similar advantage appears on the hard math split, where the base model solves only 5.04 % 5.04\% of problems.
Here, PIVOT reaches 23.05 % 23.05\% , exceeding POPE, the strongest baseline, at 22.09 % 22.09\% .
blocks.zh:
在硬逻辑游戏上,基地学生很少产生正确的解决方案,单靠结果奖励的训练对提高成绩的作用不大.
将教师产生的部分添加到推广中,如在LUFFY和POPE中,只能带来有限的改进,这两种方法的表现都比简单的SFT+RL基线差.
KDRL在学生推出过程中提供象征性级别监督,并取得更大进展,在所有三场比赛中都取得了最强的基准性能. PIVOT更进一步,将教师创造的推理部分与直接监督这些部分进行配对:通过反向的KL,它从KDRL的19.5% 19.5 %提高到35.6% 35.6 % 。
在硬数学分裂上也出现了相类似的优势,基础模型只解决了5.04%的5.04QQ问题.
这里,PIVOT达到23.05% 23.05%,超过最强基线POPE,达到22.09% 22.09%。

blocks.en:
On AIME 2024/2025 and MATH500, where the base student already solves a substantial fraction of problems, teacher guidance does not consistently improve performance.
LUFFY, POPE, and KDRL improve on MATH500 yet fall below even the base model on both AIME benchmarks, while SFT+RL brings little improvement on either. PIVOT outperforms baselines across all three benchmarks with either KL objective, with forward KL achieving the highest accuracy. PIVOT therefore benefits students both when initial success is rare and when reasoning abilities are already present.
blocks.zh:
在基础学生已经解决了相当一部分问题的AIME 2024/2025和MATH500上,教师指导并没有始终如一地提高绩效.
LUFFY、POPE和KDRL在MATH500上有所改进,但在两个AIME基准上甚至都低于基准模型,而SFT+RL对两者都没有什么改进。 PIVOT超越了所有三个基准的基线,其中任一KL目标,而前方KL的准确度最高。 因此,当初始成功很少,而且推理能力已经存在时,PIVOT不仅使学生受益。

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Effective teacher guidance in RLVR should support successful reasoning while remaining learnable for the student.
In this work, we identify two complementary mechanisms for achieving this goal: trajectory-level intervention and token-level supervision .
Existing methods typically emphasize one of them, but our analysis shows that either alone can be insufficient for student learning.
Building on this insight, we introduce PIVOT , which integrates teacher corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level supervision to those corrections.
We examine where to intervene, how to supervise, and how to allocate teacher guidance, yielding a recipe for student learning.
Experiments on logic games and mathematical reasoning demonstrate the effectiveness of combining these mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
在RLVR中有效的教师指导应当支持成功的推理,同时为学生继续学习.
在这项工作中,我们确定了实现这一目标的两个补充机制:轨迹一级的干预和象征性的监督。
现有方法通常强调其中一种方法,但我们的分析表明,只有这种方法不足以帮助学生学习。
基于这一见解,我们引入了PIVOT,它将教师矫正纳入学生推广,并对这些矫正实行象征性的监督。
我们研究在哪里进行干预、如何监督、如何分配教师指导,为学生学习提供食谱。
关于逻辑游戏和数学推理的实验证明了将这些机制结合起来的有效性.

blocks.en:
Our study has several limitations.
First, our evaluation focuses on logic games and mathematical reasoning; applicability to code generation, instruction following, and open-ended reasoning remains to be explored.
Second, PIVOT uses fixed intervention and supervision settings throughout training, even as the student’s capabilities evolve.
How to effectively adapt teacher guidance to the student’s changing needs remains an open question for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究有几个局限性。
首先,我们的评价侧重于逻辑游戏和数学推理;对代码生成的适用性、后续指示和开放式推理仍有待探讨。
第二,PIVOT在整个培训过程中使用固定的干预和监督环境,即使学生的能力在不断演变。
如何有效地使教师指导适应学生不断变化的需要,仍然是未来工作的一个未决问题。

blocks.en: Appendix A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 附录 A 实验设置

blocks.en: We detail the dataset construction, training configuration, evaluation protocol, and baseline implementations.
blocks.zh: 我们详细介绍了数据集的构建、培训配置、评价协议和基线执行情况。

blocks.en:
For synthetic logic games, we follow SynLogic ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and construct three datasets: Survo, Minesweeper, and Kakurasu.
Each game is generated at a hard difficulty setting, controlled by grid size, the number of unknown entries, and constraint density, at which the base student is near zero accuracy. Each game has 2k training problems and a held-out test split of 500 problems.
For mathematical reasoning, we pool problems from Polaris-53K ( An et al., 2025 ) and the math subset of Skywork-OR1-RL-Data ( He et al., 2025 ) , and screen them with the base student: Qwen3-4B samples 8 responses per problem, and we keep problems solved at most 3 times.
After removing problems with invalid gold answers and decontaminating against AIME 2024/2025 and MATH500, we sample 30k problems for training, 1k for validation, and a held-out in-distribution test split of 2k problems, denoted Math-ID; 77.7% of the training problems are never solved by the base student.
blocks.zh:
对于合成逻辑游戏,我们遵循SynLogic(Liu等,2026年),并构建出三个数据集:Survo,Minesweper,和Kakurasu.
每款游戏都是在硬难度设置下生成的,由网格大小,未知条目数量,和约束密度控制,其中基础生精度接近于零. 每场比赛有2k训练问题,并有500个问题的停赛测试分出.
对于数学推理,我们汇集了从Polaris-53K(An等,2025年)和Skywork-OR1-RL-Data(He等,2025年)的数学子集的问题,并用基生来筛选这些问题:Qune3-4B样本每个问题有8个响应,我们最多把问题解决了3次.
在消除了无效金子解答出的问题,并针对AIME 2024/2025和MATH500进行了去污染处理后,我们抽取出30k问题用于培训,1k问题用于验证,以及被搁置的分流测试分出2k问题,表示为"数学-ID";77.7%的训练问题从未被基地学生解决.

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted using the verl framework ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) .
We use GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) as the policy optimization algorithm, with reference KL coefficient β ref = 0.01 \beta_{\mathrm{ref}}=0.01 and clipping coefficient ε = 0.2 \varepsilon=0.2 .
Unless otherwise specified, we use a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} , a rollout batch size of 64 prompts, a mini-batch size of 32, 8 rollouts per prompt, a maximum prompt length of 2,048 tokens, and sampling temperature 0.7 for both student and teacher.
Logic-game experiments use Qwen3-1.7B as the student and Qwen3-4B-Thinking as the teacher ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; we train for 3 epochs with a maximum response length of 8,192 tokens and compute rewards with the SynLogic verifier.
Math experiments use Qwen3-4B as the student and the same teacher; we train for 1 epoch with a maximum response length of 16,384 tokens and compute rewards with Math-Verify.
No additional format or length rewards are used.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都使用活性框架进行(Sheng等人,2025年)。
我们使用GRPO(Shao等,2024年)作为政策优化算法,参考KL系数β ref = 0.01\beta_{\mathrm{ref}}=0.01和剪接系数ε0.2\varepsilon=0.2.
除非另有说明,否则我们使用3×10−6 3\times 10×6的学习速率,推出批量大小为64个急件,小型批量大小为32个,每快件8个急件,最大快件长度为2 048个令牌,对学生和教师都进行取样温度为0.7。
逻辑游戏实验使用Quen3-1.7B作为学生并使用Quen3-4B-Thinking作为老师(杨等,2025年);我们为3个纪元进行训练,最高响应长度为8,192个令牌并用SynLogic验证器计算奖励.
数学实验使用Qune3-4B作为学生和同名老师;我们为1个时代进行训练,最高响应长度为16,384个令牌并用Math-Verify计算奖励.
没有使用额外的格式或长度奖励。

blocks.en:
For each prompt, we sample G S + G T = 8 G_{S}+G_{T}=8 rollouts, where G S = 6 G_{S}=6 are student-only rollouts and G T = 2 G_{T}=2 are teacher-assisted rollouts.
By default, the teacher intervenes after a student prefix of ℓ u = 512 \ell_{u}=512 tokens and generates at most ℓ v = 4,096 \ell_{v}=4{,}096 tokens for logic games and ℓ v = 8,192 \ell_{v}=8{,}192 tokens for math.
The student then resumes autoregressive generation from the teacher-augmented context.
The teacher-generated segment is supervised with a token-level KL objective toward the teacher distribution; the placement and calibration ablations use forward KL, and we compare both directions in Section 4.3 .
The KL is computed on the teacher’s top-30 tokens, with the remaining probability mass collected into a single tail bucket.
The teacher KL coefficient β T \beta_{\mathrm{T}} is cosine-decayed from 0.1 to 0.

blocks.en:
We compare PIVOT with five representative baselines that address sparse rewards in different ways.
All baselines share the GRPO setup above and the budget of 8 rollouts per prompt.
RL only is the standard on-policy RLVR baseline without a teacher.
SFT+RL first fine-tunes the student on 5k verified-correct teacher-generated traces from the same training distribution and then continues RLVR training.
LUFFY ( Yan et al., 2025 ) replaces one of the 8 rollouts with a full teacher-generated trajectory and trains on it with LUFFY’s policy-shaping objective ( γ = 0.1 \gamma=0.1 ).
POPE ( Qu et al., 2026 ) starts 2 of the 8 rollouts from a teacher-generated prefix whose length matches our default segment length ℓ v \ell_{v} (4,096 tokens for logic games, 8,192 for math); prefix tokens are excluded from all losses and the student completes the rollout.
KDRL ( Xu et al., 2025 ) adds no teacher tokens to the trajectory; it combines GRPO with a reverse-KL distillation term on every student-generated token, computed on the student’s top-30 tokens with a constant coefficient of 0.1.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares POPE-style prefix-only guidance with supervised prefix training on Survo. Oracle prefixes are verifier-filtered teacher rollouts. blocks.en: Interpretation. The failure in this late-intervention example is consistent with insufficient budget for completing the response after solving the puzzle. A useful hand-off must leave time for verification and answer emission as well as for the remaining reasoning.
